question: After breaking into pieces, what should be deposited into the Śiva-fire and by what means?
premises: Deposit should be made in the Śiva-fire.
This is done by the root mantra.
inference: Having broken into pieces, one should deposit into the Śiva-fire by the root mantra.
uncertainties: The object deposited is implied from prior verses.
plain_english: Having broken it into pieces, one should deposit it into the Śiva-fire by the root mantra.
